summary: Backend-only iteration 3 testing for Besord. Created /app/backend/tests/test_besord_v3.py (25 new tests). Full regression: 70/70 PASSED (0 skipped, 0 failed). Real Stripe test key (sk_test_51RZJ...) verified: campaign creation hits live Stripe API, returns real checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com/ and cs_test_ (non-mock) session_id. Promo math verified: LANCAMENTO50 turns local tier 1900¢ → 950¢; WELCOME20 turns regional 4900¢ → 3920¢. /api/promos/validate returns 404 for invalid code, 400 for invalid tier, 200 case-insensitive. /api/auth/whoami returns proper authenticated/is_admin/matches_admin flags for unauth, regular and admin users. All /api/admin/* endpoints (overview, advertisers, campaigns, promos, tiers, campaign cancel, promo CRUD) gated correctly: 401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 200 admin@rodrigocontecunha. /admin/overview reports stripe_mode='TEST'. DELETE /api/posts/{id}: owner organic 200, non-owner 403, sponsored 400 ('patrocinado'), nonexistent 404. Vote geo metadata stored. Word filter and trending sort regressions pass. check-payment endpoint with real Stripe returns 200 with status='pending_payment' (no crash, no false-positive activation).
action_items: No backend action items — all 70 tests pass. Main agent may now confidently address the frontend cache issues (storage.get, refreshUser, promoCode undefined) reported by user; backend contracts are stable.
Consider stripping STRIPE_API_KEY from any future test_credentials.md mention since real secret is now in /app/backend/.env (already gitignored — verify before committing).
Optional hardening: add Stripe webhook handler (currently relies on client-side polling via /check-payment) for production reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1198 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, posts.py, campaigns.py, admin.py, promos.py, business.py with a shared deps.py (get_current_user, require_admin) and models.py. Will significantly aid future maintenance.

Stripe Checkout uses currency='usd' (line 778) but the campaign brief and pricing notes state EUR (currency=EUR) for the Lisboa/Portugal market. Confirm with main agent — should be 'eur' if Portuguese B2B audience.

create_campaign uses APP_BASE_URL for success/cancel URLs which is set to the preview backend domain in /app/backend/.env. After payment Stripe redirects to <backend>/business/campaign/{id}?paid=1 which is NOT a frontend route — should be the Expo frontend URL. Verify APP_BASE_URL points to the user-facing app, not the API.

logger is configured (lines 1166-1167) AFTER it is referenced inside create_campaign exception handler (line 796) and other places. Works due to Python's late-binding, but ordering is fragile — move logger init to top of file.

Admin gating uses raw email comparison (user['email'].lower() == ADMIN_EMAIL); good. But user_out() additionally derives is_admin which means the client receives is_admin=true and may build UI off of that — server still re-checks via require_admin() so security is fine.
matches_target compares geo['country_code'] against target_country_code with no defensive .upper() — works because both sources upper-case, but a single comparator helper would be safer.
pick_sponsored_for_user fetches up to 50 sponsored posts then filters in Python; for production scale add a Mongo $lookup or pre-filter campaigns.status='active' & ends_at>now first.
Promo expires_at parsing accepts 'Z' suffix but silently swallows parse errors (line 1128) — unparseable dates result in expires_at=None (never expires). Consider returning 400 instead.
seed_data_creation: test_besord_v3.py seeds admin user (user_admin_rodrigo, token admin_test_token_for_rodrigo_xyz123, email rodrigocontecunha@gmail.com) with business_profile, and idempotently upserts promo codes LANCAMENTO50 (50%) and WELCOME20 (20%) into db.promo_codes. Existing seeded_user from conftest.py reused for non-admin tests. Teardown cleans created campaigns/posts/sessions but leaves promo codes (so app can use them).

rca_of_issue: No bug RCAs this iteration — all flows green.
